spans.s:
m. (-शः)
1 Dress, decoration.
2 Disguise, masquerade.
3 The abode of harlots.
4 A house in general.
4 Entrance, ingress.
E.
विश to enter, (literally or figuratively, as to enter or occupy the mind,) aff. घञ्.

m. (-षः)
Ornament, dress, decoration.
E.
विष to invest, aff. घञ्.

(ऋ) वेसृ r. 1st cl. (वेसति)
To go, to move.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what enters.
m. (-कः)
A house.
f. (-शिका)
Entrance, ingress.
E.
विश to enter, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-नः)
The sun-flower.
E.
वेश ornament, and दान gift.

m. (-री)
A hypocrite, a false devotee.
E.
वेश disguise, and घारिन् having.

mfn. (-भृत्)
1 Dressed, adorned.
2 Disguised.
E.
वेश, and भृत who has.

n. (-नं)
1 A house.
2 Entering.
E.
विश to enter, ल्यट् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A basin, a small pond.
2 Fire.
E.
विश to enter, झच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
A mule; also वेसर.

m. (-रः)
A mule; also वेशर.

m. (-रः)
A condiment, as pepper, cloves, mace, &c.: see वेसवार.

m. (-रः)
A condiment; also वेसवार.

m. (-रः)
A condiment, as ground coriander, mustard, pepper, spice, &c.
E.
विस to send, aff. घञ्, वेस despatching, वॄ to choose, aff. अण्; also वेशवार and वेषवार.

mfn. (-शि-शिनी-शि)
Assuming a particular dress or form.
E.
वेश, and इनि aff.

n. (-श्म)
A house.
E.
विश to enter, मनिन् aff.

m. (-लः)
The musk shrew or rat.
E.
वेश्म a house, and नकुल an ichneumon.

f. (-भूः)
The site of a habitation.
E.
वेश्म a house, and भ ground.

f. (-णा)
The main post of a house.
E.
वेश्म् a dwelling, and स्थूणा a pillar.

n. (-श्यं)
The habitation of harlots.
f. (-श्या)
1 A harlot, a prostitute, a whore.
2 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
विश to enter, ण्यत् aff. or वेश ornament, and यत् aff.

m. (-ष्यः)
Water.
E.
विष to pervade, Uṇādi aff. प.

m. (-णः)
A company of harlots.
E.
वेश्या, and गण a number, a class.

m. (-र्य्यः)
1 A catamite.
2 The master or keeper of dancing girls, prostitutes, &c.
E.
वेश्या a whore, and आचार्य्य spiritual teacher.

m. (-यः)
The habitation of harlots, a brothel.
E.
वेश्या a whore, जन people, सम् collective particle, and आश्रय asylum.

m. (-रः)
A number or company of harlots.
E.
वेश्या, and वार assemblage.

m. (-यः)
A brothel, the habitation of harlots.
E.
वेश्या a whore, आश्रय asylum.

m. (-णः)
A shrub, (Cassia sophora.)
f. (-णा)
A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
n. (-णं)
Entrance, ingress, possession, occupation.
E.
विष to enter, &c., aff. युच्.

r. 1st cl. (वेष्टते)
To surround, to inclose, to encompass or circle.

m. (-ष्टः)
1 A fence, an enclosure.
2 Surrounding, enclosing.
3 A turban.
4 Exudation, gum, resin in general.
5 Turpentine.
E.
वेष्ट to surround, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Surrounding, a surrounder, that which encompasses or encloses.
n. (-कं)
1 A turban.
2 Exudation, resin, gum^1, &c.
3 Turpentine.
m. (-कः)
1 A wall, a fence.
2 A pumpkin gourd.
E.
वेष्ट as above, with कन् added, or वेष्ट to surround, aff. वुन्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-नं)
1 Surrounding, encompassing.
2 A wall, an enclosure, a fence.
3 A turban.
4 A diadem, a tiara.
5 The outer ear, or the meatus auditorius and the concha.
9 An attitude in dancing, a particular disposition of the hands; also a crossing of the feet.
7 Bdellium.
E.
वेष्ट to surround aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be surrounded or encompassed.
E.
वेष्ट to surround, अनीयर् aff.; also वेष्टितव्य and वेष्ट्य.

ind.
Having bound round or encompassed.
E.
वेष्ट to surround, causal v., क्त्वाच् aff.

m. (-शः)
A sort of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.)
E.
वेष्ट surrounding, and वंश a bambu.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Surrounded, encompassed, enclosed.
2 Stopped, secured from access.
3 Bound, round, enveloped, wrapped up.
n. (-तं)
1 Encompassing, encircling.
2 One of the gestures or attitudes of dancing, particular motion of the [] fingers or a crossing of the feet.
E.
वेष्ट surrounding, इतच् aff. or वेष्ट the verb, and क्त aff.
